name: Minority game: Fig. 1's memories at N = 1001
description: Challet and Zhang's Fig. 1 memories at 1001 players: σ²/N over the last 100 of 3 000 rounds against memory, with 2 or 5 strategies each. They report fluctuations 'in decreasing order' for M = 6, 8, 10 (S not stated). Measured (release, seeds 1–5, recorded 2026-09-27): S 5 — 23.0, 12.2, 6.8, 2.5, 2.3, 1.4, 0.37, 0.27, 0.25 at M 4 to 12, decreasing through 10 as they say; S 2 — the minimum at M 9 (0.11), rising again at 10 (0.14). Which S they used decides whether M 10 beats M 8.
